What
is
a
country
,
and
how
is
a
country
defined
?
When
people
ask
how
many
countries
there
are
in
the
world
,
they
expect
a
simple
answer
.
After
all
,
we've
explored
the
whole
planet
;
we
have
international
travel
,
satellite
navigation
and
plenty
of
global
organisations
like
the
United Nations
,
so
we
should
really
know
how
many
countries
there
are
!
However
,
the
answer
to
the
question
varies
according
to
whom
you
ask
.
most
people
say
there
are
192
countries
,
but
others
point
out
that
there
could
be
more
like
260
of
them
.
So
why
isn't
there
a
straightforward
answer
?
The
problem
arises
because
there
isn't
a
universally
agreed
definition
of
'
country
'
and
because
,
for
political
reasons
,
some
countries
find
it
convenient
to
recognise
or
not
recognise
other
countries
.
